prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Image1 is the exact north-facing IDLE model to preserve. Image2 is the bad north run that repeats one foot; replace its poses. Build ONE 8-frame RUN cycle viewed STRAIGHT FROM BEHIND, moving AWAY toward NORTH. EXACT FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, eight chronological frames. All eight show ONLY back of head and body, NO eyes, cheek, nose, mouth or face and NO rotation. COPY Image1's exact head silhouette, black hair tuft details, head/body ratio, shirt width and colors across all8frames. Hair median dark neutral RGB44,43,42 with restrained charcoal highlights, NO brown, gray glow or bright strands. Same muted olive shirt, yellow scarf, cream cuffs, brown belt trousers/boots and original skin. Crisp small painted game sprite, no redesign.
RUN MUST BE READABLE FROM REAR: alternating left/right foot push-offs, BENT KNEES raising each heel behind toward buttocks in turn, boot SOLES facing viewer on the recovering foot; opposite arm pumps at each raised heel. Elbows bend about90deg and swing from shoulders, hands alternately beside hips, not both locked against chest. Slight forward-away lean, tiny head bob, scarf lifts slightly. Same limb lengths and torso thickness throughout.
F1 LEFT FOOT on ground under hip supports weight, RIGHT HEEL curled HIGH behind with its SOLE VISIBLE; LEFT elbow/hand pumps backward toward viewer, RIGHT arm forward away.
F2 left leg pushes off, right foot recovers forward; arms sweep opposite.
F3 FLIGHT both feet airborne; right knee advances away, left foot extends backward; heel/sole shapes clearly different.
F4 RIGHT FOOT landing and compressing under body, LEFT HEEL begins curling up behind; RIGHT arm swings back, LEFT forward.
F5 RIGHT FOOT supports weight, LEFT HEEL curled HIGH behind with SOLE VISIBLE; RIGHT elbow/hand backward toward viewer, LEFT forward. OPPOSITE side of frame1.
F6 right leg pushes off, left foot recovers forward; arms sweep opposite.
F7 FLIGHT both feet airborne, LEFT knee advances away, RIGHT foot extends backward; OPPOSITE of frame3.
F8 LEFT FOOT landing compression, RIGHT heel starts curling behind, return smoothly to frame1.
Ground line and sprite scale identical in cells; small actual upward displacement only during flight. Clear alternating supports, not eight copies of the same sole. No sideways strides, no standing or walking shuffle. Transparent alpha background, no floor/shadow/haze, generous gutters, full hair and feet, no labels/grid/text.
